verdict.rationale: BVNK provides an extensive, documented public API covering wallets, payments, transfers, payouts, webhooks, and sandbox testing, with authentication via Hawk and clear endpoint documentation (e.g., POST /payment/v1/rules, /payment/v2/payins/simulation). This directly enables AI-native/programmatic control of the product. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer corroboration of API usability and no official SDKs/language libraries mentioned beyond docs.
